scope: Local single-JVM 28-scenario experiment; no remote execution or result reuse

notes: Local workstation, existing unrelated services retained. No Buildbarn execution.
Engine images already present; compilation measured separately; Gradle daemon warm.
Single-JVM serial test scenarios, unchanged production retries/jitter.
All three modes disable request compression and coverage instrumentation consistently.

metadata_retries.note: Production retries use exponential backoff and jitter; durations were not independently instrumented.

limitations: One 28-scenario class, not the complete 756-case integration suite.
Three replay trials, one run of each real-engine control; retry jitter and unrelated background services contribute variability.
All timings are local Gradle executions with --rerun, warm dependencies/images, a prepared classpath, and no Buildbarn or Bazel result cache.
Source snapshot cache starts empty in the ordinary real-engine run, then reuses snapshots within that run. Prepared modes reuse exact pinned ZIPs.
Request compression and JaCoCo are disabled consistently for all measured modes; default E2E compression remains enabled.
Replay validates outgoing HTTP and document payloads, not actual destination persistence/search or live snapshot creation.
Replay sets DOCKER_HOST to an invalid endpoint and has no engine-start/proxy fallback in its code; this is not an OS network sandbox.
No production retry waits were shortened; 40 failing template operations produce 160 HTTP 500 responses and 120 retry waits.
After measurement, only the recording task was hardened to disable the older snapshot cache; comparison tasks and test Java sources remained unchanged.
